title: SAS H2O MICHEL
description: h2o-michel.fr huissiers-bordeaux.com SAS H2O MICHEL is a French commissaire de justice firm (public judicial officer — serving court documents, enforcing judgments, debt recovery) created in 2018 and based in Tours/Chinon, Val de Loire (Indre-et-Loire). It is led by President Alexandra Michel and operates 5 offices (Tours, Chinon, Bourgueil, Langeais, Château-la-Vallière) with a small team of 3–7 employees. Revenue grew rapidly from €223K in 2018 to €631K in 2019 (+183%), with a strong 16.4% net margin (€103.5K net profit, ROE 85.8%) — though all accounts since 2020 are filed confidentially (estimated €600K–1M today). The firm is part of H2O Réseau National, France's first national network of commissaires de justice specialized in debt recovery (group network: 160+ staff, 6 major offices). Core services: enforcement of court decisions (saisie-attribution, wage garnishment, evictions, property seizures), debt collection, legal constats, and auction sales.
